body:
frank: Launching a preview Dedicated pool: H100v3-compact in eu-south-1 (Milan). Target: latency-sensitive medium models and multimodal inference. Preview live in ~90 minutes for limited customers.

ada: Nice — what's the initial capacity?

frank: pool_id=pool-h100v3-mil-01, nodes=12, single AZ. Billing tag = `dedicated:h100v3.eu-south-1`. Treated like h100v2 tier for quota plumbing.

sre-bot: [automation] provision_start pool=pool-h100v3-mil-01 owner=@frank expected_nodes=12

lee: Ops note: thermal profile is tighter vs legacy h100; we've set conservative freq caps and added `h100v3_throttle` monitor. Fallback routing -> eu-west-2 h100p pools on strain.

frank: Runtime validated fp16 perf and bf16 kernels. For customers using 4-bit quant, add `runtime.beta.h100v3_4bit=true` in their config.

sales: Will update marketplace tile and notify APAC/EMEA account teams. Any special contract language?

frank: Add clause "preview capacity subject to preemption for maintenance" and include billing tag.

sre-bot: [automation] provision_complete pool=pool-h100v3-mil-01 state=active nodes=12

ada: I'll post a short doc + perf snapshot once Josh uploads numbers.

frank: Quick action list:
- lee: add monitors + throttle alerts (ETA 1h)
- infra: verify billing tag propagation (ETA 30m)
- sales: marketplace + customer notice (ETA 2h)

frank: Ping @here when preview is live. Closing thread for now.
